2608.22229.title: Grounded Normative Rule Generation with Structured Search
2608.22229.paper_summary: Normative rules like institutional charters and workplace policies must be both human-readable and operationally verifiable against actual environment records. However, current language generation and structured-output benchmarks primarily reward surface fluency or schema compliance, leaving operational grounding weakly tested. This creates a critical vulnerability where standard language models generate plausible-sounding policies that fail during enforcement because they rely on unavailable data logs or misaligned scopes. To address this challenge, we formalize the problem as Grounded Normative Rule Synthesis (GNRS) and introduce GNRS-Search, a framework that utilizes Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling to optimize a discrete, five-slot And-Or Graph (AOG). By explicitly decoupling intermediate operational structure from final prose generation, this method isolates executable feasibility from writing style and allows rule failures to be localized prior to surface realization. We evaluate our approach on GNRS-Bench, a benchmark spanning 116 controlled goals across eight scene families, and RealCharter-Bench, which evaluates transfer to 53 real-derived policy tasks with hidden source clauses. GNRS-Search raises average rubric quality from 68.8% to 81.0% and ranks first under a disclosed executable composite metric, while systematic slot interventions confirm that performance gains stem from robust operational logic rather than rhetorical tuning. Ultimately, by transforming automated rule drafting into an inspectable search problem, this work provides a foundational paradigm for deploying verifiable and compliance-ready personal agents within regulated environments.
2608.22229.paper_summary_zh: 規範性規則如機構章程和工作場所政策必須同時具有人類可讀性和可操作性，能夠與實際環境記錄進行驗證。然而，目前的語言生成和結構化輸出基準主要獎勵表面流暢性或結構合規性，導致操作基礎的測試相對薄弱。這造成了一個關鍵的脆弱性，標準語言模型生成的政策聽起來合理，但在執行時失敗，因為它們依賴於不可用的數據日誌或不一致的範疇。為了解決這一挑戰，我們將問題形式化為基於實證的規範性規則合成（Grounded Normative Rule Synthesis, GNRS），並引入GNRS-Search，一個利用馬爾可夫鏈蒙特卡羅（Markov Chain Monte Carlo, MCMC）抽樣來優化離散的五槽與或圖（And-Or Graph, AOG）的框架。通過明確將中間操作結構與最終散文生成解耦，這種方法將可執行的可行性與寫作風格隔離，並允許在表面實現之前定位規則失敗。我們在GNRS-Bench上評估我們的方法，這是一個涵蓋八個場景系列的116個受控目標的基準，以及RealCharter-Bench，該基準評估轉移到53個具有隱藏源條款的真實衍生政策任務。GNRS-Search將平均評分質量從68.8%提高到81.0%，並在公開的可執行綜合指標下排名第一，而系統性的槽干預證實性能提升源自穩健的操作邏輯，而非修辭調整。最終，通過將自動化規則草擬轉變為可檢查的搜索問題，這項工作為在受監管環境中部署可驗證和合規的個人代理提供了一個基礎範式。
